title: Expense reimbursement policy
blurb: A nine-clause finance policy with a delegate rule that works, and two places a valid claim quietly dies.
subject: employee
clauses: An employee submits an expense claim with receipts within 30 days of the expense.
The employee's line manager approves or rejects the claim.
Claims above ₹50,000 also require approval from the Finance Controller after the line manager approves.
If the line manager is on leave, their delegate acts on their behalf.
Rejected claims may be corrected and resubmitted by the employee.
Approved claims are paid by Payroll in the next monthly cycle.
If a payment bounces because of incorrect bank details, Payroll informs the employee.
Claims not approved within 60 days of submission are closed automatically.
The Finance Controller reviews high-value claims on the last working day of each month.
